title: 🔅🔅Zahedan, Iran — October 1, 2026
text:
🔅🔅Zahedan, Iran — October 1, 2026"

"Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) announced Thursday that its forces killed six members of an armed group during an operation in the Manzelab area of Zahedan, the capital of Sistan and Baluchestan province, in southeastern Iran."

"According to IRGC’s Quds Regional Headquarters, the operation was launched in the early morning hours after receiving intelligence from local residents and establishing precise surveillance over the group. The targets identified as a “Takfiri terrorist cell” that was preparing to carry out an attack in the area."

"The IRGC reported that six members of the group were killed in the exchange of fire and that a number of explosive devices were discovered and seized from the scene. A clearing operation was still ongoing in the area.
